simple.meaning: סְפָר (çᵉphâr) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a census.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in 2 Chronicles, beginning at 2 Chronicles 2:16. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סְפָר (H5610) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: סְפָר (çᵉphâr) / H5610 is traced through 2 Chronicles 2:16 with source-language evidence and verse context.
